name: shopping-agent
description: Return verified product cards with evidence-bounded pricing, coupon, and purchase-link status.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.3.4 calls its auto-loaded MCP search without a preamble, searches a 45-store technically audited Shopify Storefront registry once, verifies same-product identity, and explicitly renders a dynamic MCP UI product-card snapshot. It uses authorized Chrome only after complete zero-result API coverage.
defaultPrompt: Call search_shopify_products once with no preamble; then call render_product_cards once with renderId. Never launch MCP.
